info.name: Ingest API
info.description:
Gateway API — Ingest pipeline endpoints (V3).

Updated to match BACKEND_RULES_CHECKLIST and router/ingest.go.

Variables (set in Environment or Collection):
- `urlapi`           — e.g. https://gateway.aisom.cloud/api/v1 (includes /api/v1)
- `baseUrl`          — e.g. https://gateway.aisom.cloud (root, for /events only)
- `access_token`     — Bearer JWT from Keycloak
- `orgId`            — Active org UUID
- `sourceFamily`     — Source family name (AIBOX, PVS, dahua, hikvision, mock)
- `eventId`          — Auto-captured from GET management list/single
- `templateId`       — Auto-captured from GET mappingTemplates list/single
- `targetId`         — Delivery target UUID
- `reviewId`         — Auto-captured from unknownPayloadReviews
- `patternId`        — Auto-captured from rejectedPayloadPatterns
- `deviceMgmtId`     — Auto-captured from deviceManagement
- `dlqMessageId`     — Auto-captured from DLQ
- `suggestionId`     — Auto-captured from mappingSuggestions

Response envelope:
- Success: { code, message, status: true, details }
- Error:   { code, message, status: false }
- Field must be `details` (NOT `detail`)

Source Family Modes:
- active: process normally (AIBOX, PVS)
- comingSoon: 202 Accepted, log only (dahua, hikvision)
- mock: accept + store for testing
- disabled: 423 Locked, drop

item.name: 01 — Ingest (Hot Path)
item.description:
Hot-path event ingestion. No JWT required.
POST /events/:orgId/:sourceFamily at root (uses {{baseUrl}}, no /api/v1 prefix).

Source family mode matrix:
- active (AIBOX, PVS): process ingest pipeline
- comingSoon (dahua, hikvision): 202 + log, no DB
- mock: accept + store for testing
- disabled: 423 Locked, drop

request.description:
Ingest payload for active sourceFamily AIBOX.

Expected flow:
1. Generate fingerprint (sorted key paths + normalized value types)
2. Check rejectedPayloadPattern — if match: 202 IGNORED_REJECTED_PATTERN
3. Find mappingTemplate — if found: 200 SUCCESS, process ingest
4. No template match: 202 UNKNOWN_PAYLOAD_RECORDED, create/update unknownPayloadReview

exec: pm.test('Code is SUCCESS, UNKNOWN_PAYLOAD_RECORDED, or IGNORED_REJECTED_PATTERN', () => {

event_type:string|latitude:number|longitude:number|site_name:string|threshold:number|ts:string|water_level:number

Ingest payload for comingSoon sourceFamily.
Expected: 202 Accepted, message='sourceFamily is coming soon', no DB write.

Ingest payload for comingSoon sourceFamily hikvision.
Expected: 202 Accepted, no DB write.

Ingest payload for mock sourceFamily.

item.name: 08 — Mapping Templates
item.description:
Mapping template CRUD with classification rules and delivery target binding.
Requires Bearer JWT + X-Active-Org.

Minimal fields for V3: orgId, name, sourceFamily, matchRule, fieldMappings, target, messageTemplate, enabled.

classificationRules: derives canonical eventClass/eventSeverity from payload fields.
deliveryTargets: binds targets with optional payload filter, eventClasses, eventSeverities whitelist.
messageTemplates: locale-aware notification text (key-based selection via messageTemplateKey).
dlq: per-template dead-letter queue configuration.

eventClass enum: unknown, anonymous, whitelist, watchlist, vip, blacklist, redlist, custom
eventSeverity enum: none, info, warning, critical

request.description: Returns paginated list of mapping templates.
Creates a mapping template with sourceFamily, classification rules, delivery targets, DLQ, and message templates.
Returns a single mapping template by ID.
Patches name and mappings on a mapping template. Only provided fields are updated.

Sets classificationRules on a template.
Rules evaluated in order (ascending). First match sets eventClass/eventSeverity.
Defaults if no rule matches: eventClass=unknown, eventSeverity=none.

Full delivery setup: webhook (all events) + LINE (blacklist/watchlist, warning/critical) + Discord (critical only).
Target types: webhook, line, discord, telegram.
Updates DLQ configuration on a template.
Deletes a mapping template. Invalidates fingerprint cache immediately.

item.name: 10 — Unknown Payload Reviews
item.description:
Unknown payload review management.
Created when ingest receives a payload with no matching template.
Status: pending | rejected (no resolved, no archived).
Required fields: orgId, sourceFamily, fingerprint, samplePayload, candidateSuggestionIds, seenCount, firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt, status.
Requires Bearer JWT + X-Active-Org.

request.description:
Returns paginated list of unknown payload reviews.
Each review includes: fingerprint (sorted key paths + normalized value types), samplePayload, seenCount, candidateSuggestionIds.

Rejects an unknown payload review.
Automatically creates a rejectedPayloadPattern so future payloads with the same fingerprint are silently dropped.

item.name: 11 — Rejected Payload Patterns
item.description:
Rejected payload patterns — silently dropped fingerprints.
Key: sourceFamily + fingerprint.
If a new ingest request matches a rejected pattern, it is dropped without creating a review.
Delete a pattern to re-enable review for that fingerprint.
Required fields: sourceFamily, fingerprint, reason, createdAt, createdBy.
Requires Bearer JWT + X-Active-Org.

request.description: Returns paginated list of rejected payload patterns.

Deletes a rejected payload pattern.
After deletion, future payloads with this fingerprint will create unknownPayloadReview records again.

item.name: 12 — DLQ (Dead-Letter Queue)
item.description:
Dead-letter queue for failed ingest processing.
Stages: normalize | deliver | webhook.
Status: pending | retrying | resolved | abandoned.
Requires Bearer JWT + X-Active-Org.

request.description: Returns paginated list of DLQ messages.
Returns DLQ statistics: counts by status and stage, avg retry count, oldest message age.

Schedules a retry for a DLQ message. Increments retryCount, sets status to retrying.
Replays a DLQ message from the beginning of the pipeline.
Abandons a DLQ message. Sets status to abandoned, no further retries.
